title: I create content about mountains, outdoor sports and climate change.
body: Since I was young, I have been running through mountains and forests. Through my mountain sports practices, I question our relationship with the living world and the mountains.

title: I created a digital media from scratch. With zero funds, zero network.
body: The dance ecosystem was completely split in two: large productions and TikTok videos. There was an opportunity to create a platform that would bring dancers together and create content that was both artistic and viral. And so we did.

title: I launched a podcast about the overlooked aspects of everyday life.
body: During Covid, I decided to launch a podcast to embrace the small things we no longer see because our world is too noisy, too fast, too overwhelming. This podcast is an invitation to rediscover the little things of the mundane, the usual, and the everyday.
